reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because the title and description present it as an official public address at a ceremonial foundation stone event, with frames showing a decorated venue, attendees, stage signage, and a speaker at a podium. The request to subscribe to the Prime Minister Office's official YouTube channel is ordinary channel engagement and is not tied to a deceptive benefit, transaction, or data request.

citations.quote: PM Modi's address at laying of foundation stone of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir | PMO
Prime Minister Narendra Modi addresses public function at laying of foundation stone of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh

opening.argument: The description pairs a direct viewer action with a set of off-platform destinations: viewers are told to subscribe and then directed toward the PMO website and social-media channels. That combination can function as a solicitation funnel, because engagement is explicitly requested before viewers are encouraged to continue through external links. The public-event framing does not itself explain why a ceremonial address needs this broader action pathway. While no specific payout is stated, the call to act and the linked destinations are sufficient to present the video as actively soliciting participation rather than merely documenting an event.

citations.quote: ►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office's official Youtube channel.
You can also connect with us on the official PMO website & other Social Media channels

rebuttal.rebuttal: The description does not merely identify an event; it gives viewers a subscription instruction and a shortened external link, then adds several further destinations. Calling these ordinary engagement does not address why the viewer is being moved through multiple action points. The title and event description establish subject matter, but they do not establish that the linked solicitation is harmless or purely documentary.

citations.quote: PM Modi's address at laying of foundation stone of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir | PMO
►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office's official Youtube channel.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The action requested is only subscription to the identified official channel, and the remaining text offers official PMO information channels. Nothing in these quoted instructions promises money, a reward, an investment return, or any benefit for subscribing or clicking. The event is explicitly described as a public address at a foundation-stone ceremony, so the engagement request does not establish a deceptive claim or loss mechanism.

citations.quote: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addresses public function at laying of foundation stone of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh
►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office's official Youtube channel.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together in the description: a shortened URL, a request to subscribe, and invitations to connect through a website and multiple social channels. The wording also presents these destinations as official, which increases the persuasive force of the solicitation and may discourage ordinary scrutiny. The supplied frames show a highly staged, authoritative setting and a prominent speaker, conditions that can make viewers more willing to follow accompanying links. No payment is visible, but a scam need not disclose its harmful step in the event footage itself; the combination of authority, external routing, and direct engagement language warrants treating the presentation as deceptive promotion.

citations.quote: ►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office's official Youtube channel.
Get the latest updates :bell: from PM's Office
You can also connect with us on the official PMO website & other Social Media channels

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference characterization treats the surrounding ceremony as dispositive, but a formal venue and recognizable speaker can also lend credibility to an accompanying link campaign. The presence of a subscription request is expressly conceded by the description, and the shortened URL remains an external routing mechanism. The opening does not explain why these risk signals should be disregarded merely because the event itself is public.

citations.quote: ►Subscribe https://goo.gl/C3hVED | to Prime Minister Office's official Youtube channel.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited signals are not scam indicators without a deceptive offer. The shortened link is identified as the official YouTube channel, while the other destinations are described as official PMO channels. The frame shows a speaker at a ceremonial podium, but it does not show a payment request, reward, credential demand, or harmful outcome. Authority and external links alone do not establish fraud.

official PMO website & other Social Media channels

opening.argument: Although presented as an address, the material also operates as promotional distribution for a government media channel. The description repeatedly directs viewers to subscribe, obtain updates, and connect through the PMO's website and social accounts. That call to expand the channel's reach is not necessary to identify the ceremony; it steers viewers toward continued engagement. The event setting and branded presentation amplify that steering effect, making the content function as an authoritative promotional gateway rather than neutral coverage. The absence of a visible transaction does not eliminate the possibility that the solicitation is the deceptive mechanism.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense labels the subscription request ordinary engagement without confronting the broader promotional package: subscribe, receive updates, and connect through several channels. The title identifies an address, but that does not prevent the description from using the address as a vehicle for audience acquisition. The ceremonial visuals may explain viewer trust, yet they also make the promotional steering more credible.

citations.quote: PM Modi's address at laying of foundation stone of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir | PMO
Get the latest updates :bell: from PM's Office

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The material's role is still a public address at a named ceremonial event, and the promotional language concerns following official information channels. It does not ask viewers to pay, transfer assets, disclose credentials, recruit others, or claim a return. Reframing ordinary channel distribution as a scam does not supply the missing deceptive promise or concrete harm mechanism.
